reason: Read with the printed texts at hand, the lesson incipits and words the image-only reading had left uncertain became clear, among them Mater generis nostri, Leta maria gestat, inquit, and the Kings rubric Dominica viii.
sources: Peter Chrysologus, Sermo 127, De decollatione S. Joannis Baptistae, PL 52, cols. 549-550, page image https://archive.org/details/patrologiaecursu0052mign/page/n276
Ps.-Augustine, Sermo 194, De Annuntiatione Dominica II, PL 39, cols. 2104-2106, page image https://archive.org/details/patrologiaecursu0039mign/page/n310
Paschasius Radbertus, Cogitis me (Ps.-Jerome, Epistola 9), §16, PL 30, cols. 139-140, page image https://archive.org/details/patrologiaecursu0030jpmi/page/n73
text:
F-gieu (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 70). Source-assisted reading, 31 October 2026, made with PL 52, PL 39, PL 30, the Vulgate and Cantus Index at hand. A research reader reread these pages on the native images: canvas 1 upper left and upper right pages in full; canvas 1 lower right page, last nine lines; canvas 0 lower right page; canvas 2 left and right pages; canvas 3 right page, lower half; canvas 3 left page, lines 17-25 (reread after an independent check). All other lines rest on the image-only first reading.
Conventions: expansions in ( ), lost or supplied text in [ ], ? doubtful, / line break. Boxes are x,y,width,height in native pixels (4912 x 7360).

== canvas 1 (Stams_STA_Frg_070_01v02v), upper bifolium, right page, box 2600,650,1800,2200
[...] pluuia descendat sup(er) uos. ubi ceciderunt [...] / [...] [red:] In .ii. n(octurno) a(ntiphona). Unus? defensor. [red:] a(ntiphona). Adorate / d(omi)n(u)m. [red:] a(ntiphona) [...] [red:] V. [...] media nocte surgeba(m). [red:] Lc. v. / A[nna] cum esset amaro animo orauit ad d(omi)n(u)m / flens largiter. et uotu(m) uouit dicens. / D(omi)ne exercituu(m) si respiciens uideris af- / flictione(m) famule tue et recordatus mei / fueris nec oblitus ancille tue. dederisq(ue) / serue tue sexu(m) uirile(m) dabo eu(m) d(omi)no o(mn)ib(us) / dieb(us) uite eius et nouacula no(n) ascendet / sup(er) caput eius. [red:] R. Montes gelboe nec ros nec / pluuia ueniant sup(er) uos ubi ceciderunt fortes is- / rael. [red:] V. Omnes montes qui in circuitu eius sunt uisitet / d(omi)n(u)s a gelboe aute(m) transeat. Ubi. [red:] Lc. vi. / F[actum est] aut(em) cu(m) illa multiplicaret preces / cora(m) d(omi)no ut heli obseruaret os eius. / Porro anna loquebatur in corde suo. tantumq(ue) / labia eius mouebantur. et uox penitus / n(on) audiebatur. Estimauit eam ergo heli te- / mulenta(m) dixitq(ue) ei. Usquequo ebria eris. / Digere paulisper uinu(m) quo mades. [red:] R. Exau- / disti d(omi)ne orac(i)o(n)em serui tui ut edificare(m) templu(m) no(min)i / tuo. Benedic et sanctifica domu(m) istam i(n) sempiternu(m) deus isr(ae)l.

== canvas 2 (Stams_STA_Frg_070_03r), left page, box 1000,2650,1550,1750 (later black flourishes over the lower lines)
[...]alternantibus modul(is) dulcisona carmi- / na misceantur. [red:] R. Corde (et) a(n)i(m)o xp(ist)o canam(us) gl(ori)- / am. In hac sacra sollempnitate p(re)celse genitricis / dei marie. [red:] V. Omnis pariter (con)gregati d(e)o collaudem(us). / A[red initial]udite ergo. que(m)admodu(m) [red:] Lc. vij. In- / tympanistria n(ost)ra cantauit. Ait / enim. Magnificat a(n)i(m)a mea d(omi)n(u)m. Et exul- / tauit sp(iritu)s meus in deo salutari meo. O / b(eat)a [...] omne captiuu(m) [...] / dep(re)catur assensu(m). Te d(omi)na mu(n)dus sue / fidei obside(m) fecit. Noli morari uirgo / nuncio festinant(er) responde u(er)bu(m) (et) susci- / pe filiu(m). Da fide(m) (et) senti u(ir)tute(m). [red:] R. Regali / ex progenie maria exorta refulget. Cui(us) p(re)cib(us) / nos adiuuari me(n)te (et) sp(irit)u deuotissi(m)e poscim(us). [red:] V. / Corde (et) a(n)i(m)o xp(ist)o canam(us) gl(ori)am in hac sacra sol- / lempnitate genitricis dei marie. Cui(us). [red:] Lc. viij. / E[initial]cce inq(ui)t ancilla d(omi)ni. fiat m(ichi) s(e)c(un)d(u)m
